snippet.title: Carbon Teaser - Steam next fest
snippet.description:
We're thrilled to announce our participation in the upcoming Steam Next Fest, running from February 24 to March 3, 2025. During this week-long event, you'll have the exclusive opportunity to experience a free demo of our latest game, Carbon. 

Steam page - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012300/Carbon/
Discord server - https://discord.com/invite/dT68qHc
